##### Project general facts

Elaya presents an exquisite collection of contemporary and refined residential apartments, offering a wonderful variety of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom homes. Every layout is thoughtfully designed to prioritize both privacy and comfort, creating a brightly illuminated and generously proportioned living space. Residents can look forward to modern living and unparalleled leisure in a truly first-class residence.

The community offers an unparalleled range of facilities for a life of comfort and convenience. Residents can enjoy a stunning swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, basketball and tennis courts, a wave rider, BBQ areas, and dedicated kids' play areas for the whole family to enjoy. Retail outlets and supermarkets are also on hand, ensuring every interest and need is wonderfully catered to.

Every entrance at Elaya welcomes residents into serenity, where warm colors, natural themes, and hand-selected materials blend beautifully to create a true sanctuary. Interiors highlight glazed porcelain flooring, integrated closets, and a fully equipped kitchen, all finished to an elegant standard. This wonderful blend of modern design and practicality transforms every residence into a center of efficiency and elegance.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
